subject: words
title: -er and -est
about: Comparing words in pairs: -er compares two things (taller) and -est means the most of all (tallest). NC L.1.4 covers using word parts to work out meaning and RF.1.4.f covers reading words with endings; CKLA Grade 1 teaches adjectives in Units 4 and 6, and his readers use these words from Unit 4 on.
tip: Line up three toys and ask: which one is taller, and which one is the tallest of all?

cards.note: fast + er. -er compares two: a rabbit is faster than a turtle.
fast + est. -est is the most of all: a rocket is the fastest.
tall + er. -er compares two: a giraffe is taller than a horse. The a in tall says aw.
tall + est. -est is the most of all: the mountain is the tallest.
long + er. -er compares two: a snake is longer than a worm.
long + est. -est is the most of all: the train is the longest.
small + er. -er compares two: a mouse is smaller than a cat. The a in small says aw.
small + est. -est is the most of all: the ant is the smallest.
Double the g, then add er: big, bigger. -er compares two: an elephant is bigger than a dog.
Double the g, then add est: big, biggest. -est is the most of all: the whale is the biggest.
slow + er. -er compares two: a turtle is slower than a dog. The ow in slow says long o.
slow + est. -est is the most of all: the snail is the slowest.
soft + er. -er compares two: a teddy is softer than a rock.
soft + est. -est is the most of all: the pillow is the softest.
cold + er. -er compares two: snow is colder than rain. The o in cold says its name.
cold + est. -est is the most of all: ice is the coldest.
kind + er. -er compares two: sharing is kinder than grabbing. The i in kind says its name.
kind + est. -est is the most of all: the kindest friend.
high + er. -er compares two: a balloon goes higher than a kite. igh says long i: hi.
high + est. -est is the most of all: the mountain top is the highest.
